# Analyses

Analyses answer questions about a project's area of influence from Earth observation and map data: how steep the land is, where water drains, what covers the land, how many people live there, what is built. Each one reads open datasets for the area, processes them on the server and returns figures, tables, maps and downloads, with a record of the data and settings used. General GIS processing (buffer, clip, zonal statistics, reclassify…) is in the [Toolbox](../introduction/toolbox.md).

Each page below explains every analysis in its category: the question it answers, the data it reads, its settings, how it turns the data into results (workflow and method), what it produces, and its limitations.

| Category | Analyses | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| [Terrain and site conditions](terrain.md) | 5 | What is the physical setting of the site? Elevation, slope, aspect, contours, landforms and soils. |
| [Water resources](water.md) | 3 | Where does water come from and go? Catchments, rivers, surface water, rainfall, evapotranspiration and water accounting. |
| [Land, vegetation and agriculture](land.md) | 6 | What covers the land and how productive is it? Land cover and change, vegetation indices, fields, crops and forests. |
| [People and socio-economics](people.md) | 5 | Who lives here and how well served are they? Population, settlements, access, electrification and wealth. |
| [Infrastructure and services](infrastructure.md) | 5 | What is built and what services exist? Buildings, transport, schools, health, public facilities, power and utilities. |
| [Site selection and planning](planning.md) | 1 | Where should the intervention go? Suitability, candidate sites, service gaps and alternatives. |

## All analyses

| Analysis | Category | Question |

| [Access to services](people.md#access-to-services) | People and socio-economics | How many people live within reach of schools, clinics, markets, water points and roads? |
| [Population and density](people.md#population-and-density) | People and socio-economics | How many people live in the area, where, and per admin unit? |
| [Population change](people.md#population-change) | People and socio-economics | How fast has the population grown since 2000? |
| [Settlements and urbanisation](people.md#settlements-and-urbanisation) | People and socio-economics | Which villages and towns are there, how large, how urban? |
| [Travel time to cities and health care](people.md#travel-time-to-cities-and-health-care) | People and socio-economics | How remote is the area from towns, cities and health care? |
| [Area profile](infrastructure.md#area-profile) | Infrastructure and services | What is mapped in the project area? |

| [Road network](infrastructure.md#road-network) | Infrastructure and services | How many kilometres of road are mapped in the project area, of what class and surface? |
| [Schools in the area](infrastructure.md#schools-in-the-area) | Infrastructure and services | Which schools are mapped inside the project area, and where? |
| [Site suitability](planning.md#site-suitability) | Site selection and planning | Where does an intervention fit best, given your own conditions on terrain, land, water, people and access? |

To add an analysis, see [Adding an analysis module](../development/adding-a-module.md). These pages are generated from each analysis' `manifest.yaml` and `METHOD.md` with `python manage.py document_analyses`.
